note: Lab run 2: canonical penguin + cameo test across media
image_rules: No watermark, no border, no real logos, brands or real people. Spell any text exactly. The penguin must match the reference sheet exactly: eye-rings, orange beak tip, orange feet, three-feather tuft.

character.prompt: Character model sheet for an original mascot, designer-vinyl-toy look with soft studio lighting on a plain warm grey background. THE PENGUIN (original mascot, fixed traits, keep all of them): a small, round, egg-shaped Adelie-type penguin, a bit bottom-heavy. Black head and back, clean white belly. Big round white eye-rings that make it look permanently curious. Small dark beak with an orange tip. Slightly oversized bright orange feet. Flippers a little too short (it cannot fly). SIGNATURE: three thin stubborn feathers sticking up from the top of its head, slightly bent. Personality: nosy, deadpan, quietly unlucky. Never talks. Top row: front view, three-quarter view, side view, back view. Bottom row, four expressions: wide-eyed curious stare, deadpan side-eye, startled with feathers standing up, embarrassed after falling over. Small clean label 'CURIOUS PENGUIN' in the corner.

scenes.prompt: Tilt-shift miniature photograph: a cable repair ship alone on a vast grey-green sea at dawn, looking like a real model set, with focus bands top and bottom. Hidden among the crates on the deck, very small in frame, the penguin from the reference wears a tiny hard hat and a hi-vis vest and peeks out. A spot-the-penguin moment.

Still from a 1970s 16mm documentary: a cable landing station control room full of blinking equipment, two engineers in short-sleeved shirts arguing over a long printout. In the background on top of a filing cabinet, the penguin from the reference sits holding a tiny coffee mug, clearly eavesdropping. Warm film grain, faded colours, soft halation.

Claymation miniature set: a single garden hose stretching across a moonlit seabed into the darkness, glowing faintly orange. The penguin from the reference is caught mid-trip over the hose, flippers flailing, one foot in the air, frozen at the peak of the fall. Stop-motion texture, fingerprints in the clay.

Technical cross-section of a deep-sea fibre optic cable on cyanotype paper, white linework on Prussian blue, with neat labels: 'POLYETHYLENE', 'STEEL WIRES', 'COPPER TUBE', 'OPTICAL FIBRES'. Beside it, the penguin from the reference drawn in the same white linework as a size comparison, labelled 'FOR SCALE (APPROX.)'.

Classical oil painting in the style of an old master allegory: a bearded sea god rising from the waves, puzzled, holding a tangle of thin cables like a fishing net. In the lower corner, the penguin from the reference wears a tiny toga and points at the cables with total confidence. Dramatic chiaroscuro, cracked varnish texture.

videos.prompt: Stop-motion claymation, locked-off camera: the penguin finishes tripping over the glowing hose, faceplants into the sand with a small puff, then slowly sits up, dazed, and looks straight at the camera. Stop-motion frame rate, comic timing. No text.
